rounds.name: Discovery Corpus Ingestion and 5-Candidate Synthesis
rounds.purpose: Screen 54 seed papers in soft robotics variable stiffness, synthesize candidate directions, adversarial critique, and select D1.
rounds.start_state: 54 seed papers across soft robotics layer jamming
rounds.completion_state: D1 selected by Sol adjudication; discovery outputs frozen
rounds.key_findings: Identified 5 candidate directions; selected D1 for initial adversarial audit.

rounds.name: D1 First Adversarial Verification Round
rounds.purpose: Attempt to falsify original D1 claim (layer jamming continuum robot) against Narang 2018, Caruso 2023.
rounds.completion_state: High-confidence PIVOT verdict; P1 candidate formulated
rounds.key_findings: Direct prior art (Narang 2018, Caruso 2023) killed original general layer-jamming novelty; pivoted to P1 (validity limits of homogenized slip model).

rounds.name: D1 Second Verification Round (2025 Continuum Models)
rounds.purpose: Ingest and attack P1 against newly published 2025 continuum models (Zhang 2025 continuum beam).
source_artifacts: data/papers/verification/D1-V002/2025-A continuum-based model for a layer jamming beam.pdf
rounds.completion_state: Target reduced model M1 (Zhang et al. 2025) identified
rounds.key_findings: Zhang 2025 continuum beam model identified as explicit baseline M1 under evaluation.

rounds.name: D1 Third Verification Round (Validity Gap Audit)
rounds.purpose: Audit validity gap and cross-round synthesis on continuum layer jamming models.
rounds.start_state: Targeted search on continuum model validity limits
rounds.completion_state: Scope narrowed; survives with revised scope
rounds.key_findings: Model form error across layer count and pressure identified as surviving narrow gap.

rounds.name: D1 Fourth Verification Round (C01 Adversarial Audit)
rounds.purpose: Audit relative gradient theory, composite slip, and layered mechanics prior art.
rounds.key_findings: Homogenization in composite beams distinguished from discrete layer contact mechanics.

rounds.name: D1 Fifth Verification Round (C02 Adversarial Audit)
rounds.purpose: Audit multi-layered beam partial interaction and shear deformation literature.
rounds.completion_state: C02 audited; partial interaction differences mapped
rounds.key_findings: Partial interaction literature focused on 2-layer steel-concrete; multi-layer frictional contact unclosed.

rounds.name: D1 Sixth Verification Round (C03 Adversarial Audit)
rounds.purpose: Audit interface friction, bolted joints, and microscopic roughness mechanics.
rounds.completion_state: C03 audited; contact pressure redistribution isolated
rounds.key_findings: Microscopic joint models do not solve continuum beam validity limits.

rounds.name: D1 Seventh Verification Round (C04 Adversarial Audit)
rounds.purpose: Audit chiral, coupled, and multi-physics beam models; semantic correction.
rounds.key_findings: Coupled electromagnetic and chiral models separated from pure layer-jamming continuum mechanics.

rounds.name: D1 Eighth Verification Round (Final Named Target Audit)
rounds.purpose: Attack survival of D1 against Ye 2024 (nonlinear interfacial slip).
rounds.key_findings: Ye 2024 solves 2-layer steel-concrete with bond-slip constitutive law; does not solve N-layer vacuum beam validity boundary.

rounds.name: D1 Ninth Verification Round (Late-Found Adjacent Audit)
rounds.purpose: Attack survival of D1 against Adhikary 1999 (large deformation cohesive-frictional).
rounds.key_findings: Adhikary 1999 uses Cosserat continuum for geological jointed rock mass; does not resolve vacuum layer-jamming beam model validity breakdown.

rounds.name: Final Cross-Direction Adjudication (D1/M1 vs MP1)
rounds.purpose: 18-criterion head-to-head comparison between surviving D1_M1 and surviving MP1 candidates.
rounds.start_state: Two surviving directions after verification workflows
rounds.completion_state: D1_M1 selected with conditional feasibility gate; MP1 closed and archived as viable alternative
rounds.key_findings: D1_M1 selected because baseline model M1 is concrete, fewer confounding mechanisms, manageable MSc experimental burden.

rounds.name: Master Plan V1-V5 Audit and Remediation Iterations
rounds.purpose: Iterative hardening of D1 execution plan through audits A1-A5 and remediations R1-R5.
rounds.completion_state: Plan V5 remediated to Plan V6
rounds.key_findings: Systematically resolved architectural issues, multi-writer ambiguities, failure routing, and gate alignments.

rounds.name: Master Plan V6 Targeted Re-Audit D1-A6
rounds.purpose: Independent re-audit verifying resolution of A5-HI-01 (ownership) and A5-HI-02 (failure routing).
rounds.key_findings: Ownership conflicts=0; worker failure routing verified 12/12; package manifest valid.
